items.title: A Family-Owned Business with National Reach
items.body:
Tristar UK Ltd was established over 30 years ago with a single mission: to provide the UK building trade with direct access to high-quality surface protection and site materials without the middleman markups.

As a family-owned enterprise based in Stevenage, we have grown from a small regional distributor into a nationwide importer, maintaining direct relationships with global manufacturers to ensure our stockists receive only the best.

We aren't just a supplier; we are a strategic partner for builders' merchants and independent retailers across the country.

config.title: Cotton Dust Sheets & Floor Protection
config.subtitle: Professional-grade surface protection trusted by contractors across the UK

items.title: Contractor to Heavy-Duty Professional range
items.body: From lightweight 1.4kg contractor sheets to 1.9kg heavy-duty professional grade, our full range of cotton twill and calico dust sheets offer reusable, machine-washable protection for every decorating scenario — floors, furniture, stairs and more. All sourced directly from the manufacturer.

config.title: Tarpaulins & Sheeting
config.subtitle: Heavy-duty cover solutions for indoor and outdoor trade applications

items.title: General Purpose to Professional use
items.body: Our tarpaulin range covers everything from lightweight 80g blue all-purpose covers to 175g extra-strong green heavy-duty tarps and clear Leno/Mono tarpaulins for applications requiring light penetration. Available in a wide range of sizes from 6ft x 4ft up to 10m x 17m.

config.title: Sacks, Bags & Waste Management
config.subtitle: Heavy-duty waste containment for building sites and trade professionals

items.title: From Rubble to Refuse Sacks
items.body: Our comprehensive sacks and bags range includes heavy-duty blue and black rubble sacks, woven polypropylene tonne bags rated to 1000kg, wheelie bin liners, garden sacks, carrier bags and pallet wrap. Built to handle the rigours of professional site use.

config.title: Brushes, Rollers & Decorating Tools
config.subtitle: Professional decorating accessories for every finish and application

items.title: Contractor to Professional Grade
items.body: Our decorating range covers 4", 7" and 9" roller tray sets in foam, synthetic, microfibre and tiger stripe, plus Contractor and Acer paint brushes from 0.5" to 4". All technically vetted for professional use. Masonry brushes, scrapers, filling knives, masking tape and Mirka sandpaper also available.
